Kevin Trudeau's warning: your own medicine cabinet may be part of the problem.

His point: everyday over-the-counter pills like Tylenol, Advil and Dramamine can drain the body of magnesium, calcium, vitamin E and omega-3 - and magnesium is one of the most common deficiencies behind high blood pressure.

His own fix: a full-spectrum vitamin E with tocotrienols (he names Unique E as one he trusts), alongside magnesium and calcium in the right ratio.

Comment HEALTH and we'll send you the label to look for.

#kevintrudeau #bloodpressure #magnesium #wbdaily #readthelabel #healthtruth

Kevin Trudeau's two to eliminate if blood pressure is a struggle: corn and wheat that haven't been properly fermented, plus excitotoxins like MSG, aspartame and sucralose.

His real-world example: the 'healthy' protein shake. He says most people never flip the label - and many are loaded with sucralose and NutraSweet, the same two ingredients he ties to brain fog, weight gain and rising blood pressure.

Next shake you reach for, read the ingredient line before you drink it.

Kevin Trudeau's blunt fix for high blood pressure: move, specifically.

His own list: walking, a rebounder (he credits his friend Al Carter), or a vibration plate like a Hyper Vibe or Power Plate - anything that shakes the whole body, not one muscle.

His other go-tos: yoga, and any mix of cardio and strength training, done regularly.

His real point: staying still is one of the quiet drivers of high blood pressure most people never address.
